observation.command:
cd /tmp
LATEST=$(curl -fsSL -H 'Accept: application/json' https://github.com/ddev/ddev/releases/latest | sed -e 's/.*"tag_name":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/')
echo "LATEST=$LATEST"
TARBALL="ddev_linux-amd64.$LATEST.tar.gz"
BASE="https://github.com/ddev/ddev/releases/download/$LATEST"
curl -fsSL "$BASE/$TARBALL" -o "$TARBALL" && echo "downloaded tarball"
curl -fsSL "$BASE/$TARBALL.sha256.txt" -o "$TARBALL.sha256.txt" && echo "downloaded sha"
sha256sum --ignore-missing -c "$TARBALL.sha256.txt"
tar -xzf "$TARBALL" && ls -la ddev ddev-hostname mkcert
chmod +x ddev ddev-hostname mkcert
mv -f ddev ddev-hostname mkcert /usr/local/bin/
which ddev; ddev --version
